findings.impact: If valid, a synced collection-level credential can be exposed to anyone with collection read access and can leak into exports, logs, or automation.
remediation: Determine whether the value is still valid without reproducing it.
Replace the synced plaintext value with a Postman Vault/secret-backed reference or runtime-injected secret.
Read back the collection and confirm no plaintext credential remains.
Only then enable automated collection execution or monitors.
findings.reason: No credential mutation or rotation was performed without a verified dependency-safe remediation path.
